purpose: Static-call targets that must remain OpenSPM host side exits while M14 replaces Wii platform services with native PC services.
source: SPM-M14 natural-title diagnostic proof plus exact player-generated R8PE01 whole-DOL verification. Diagnostic-only probes/private sentinels are excluded; their real semantic targets are recorded instead. Tiny PPC helpers whose complete architectural effects are reproduced inline are also excluded. GXBeginDisplayList/GXEndDisplayList are no longer whole-function host exits: local-module bridge v19 keeps their recompiled CPU-side GXData/FIFO shadow semantics native and uses continuation-safe return-label hooks to bracket only OpenSPM's neutral physical display-list recorder.

policy.goal: Replace each temporary compatibility boundary with an OpenSPM-owned native service; do not execute Wii device stacks as the final architecture. Tiny complete PPC helpers may be reproduced inline when their architectural side effects are fully known. Recompiled SDK CPU-side shadow/context semantics should remain native when physical device transport can be isolated behind durable OpenSPM seams.
